\n\xe3\x06\n\x02\x06\x00\x12\x04\x15\x00$\x01\x1a\xd6\x06 InferenceService \xe2\x80\x94 the wire surface for the engine\'s inference verb.\n\n `Infer` is an imperative session method, not a SQL query, so it lives as a\n typed gRPC RPC alongside SessionService / TriggerService / EmbeddingService\n rather than on the Flight SQL surface (which carries query/result only, per\n ADR-01 \xc2\xa73.2). The verb is a substrate primitive: it names the act of running\n a model over a source, not any tenant-domain concept.\n\n The verb delegates 1:1 to the consumer-facing `Session`\n abstraction; the service reimplements no model loading, scan, or forward\n logic \xe2\x80\x94 it is purely a wire adapter over the in-process engine.\n\n Tenant scope is read from the request\'s `SessionTenant` extension, set by the\n shared TenantInterceptor from the `jammi-session-id` header \xe2\x80\x94 the same\n mechanism every other gRPC service and Flight SQL already use.\n\n\n\n\x03\x06\x00\x01\x12\x03\x15\x08\x18\n\xae\x02\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x00\x12\x03\x1a\x022\x1a\xa0\x02 Scan `columns` on a registered source, run `model_id` over every row for\n `task`, and return the result as Arrow IPC. Peer of the abstraction\'s\n `infer`, which returns `Vec<RecordBatch>` \xe2\x80\x94 the batches are carried in one\n `ArrowBatch` (the same Flight-IPC pairing TriggerService uses).\n\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x00\x01\x12\x03\x1a\x06\x0b\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x00\x02\x12\x03\x1a\x0c\x18\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x00\x03\x12\x03\x1a#0\n\x9b\x04\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x01\x12\x03#\x028\x1a\x8d\x04 Predict one target\'s distribution with a trained in-context predictor (S19)\n by assembling its live context and running one in-context forward \xe2\x80\x94 no\n gradient update. Peer of the engine\'s `predict_with_context_predictor`\n (the provenanced form): returns the predictive distribution plus the\n assembly `source` fact and the context member keys, so a graph-conditioned\n prediction is never unattributed. Lives on InferenceService because it is a\n serving verb \xe2\x80\x94 running a model over a source \xe2\x80\x94 not a training submission.\n\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x01\x01\x12\x03#\x06\r\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x01\x02\x12\x03#\x0e\x1c\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x01\x03\x12\x03#\'6\n\xf5\x03\n\x02\x05\x00\x12\x04-\x003\x01\x1a\xe8\x03 Opt-in producer memoization, shared across the result-table producer verbs\n (`Infer`, `GenerateEmbeddings`, `BuildNeighborGraph`, `PropagateEmbeddings`).\n Mirrors the engine\'s `CachePolicy`. UNSPECIFIED maps to the engine default\n (`Bypass`, always recompute) \xe2\x80\x94 the documented mapping, matching how every\n other `*_UNSPECIFIED` arm here resolves to its engine default; an out-of-range\n enum value is the loud `invalid_argument` the shared decoder builds, never a\n silent fall-through.\n\n\n\n\x03\x05\x00\x01\x12\x03-\x05\x10\n\x0b\n\x04\x05\x00\x02\x00\x12\x03.\x02\x1f\n\x0c\n\x05\x05\x00\x02\x00\x01\x12\x03.\x02\x1a\n\x0c\n\x05\x05\x00\x02\x00\x02\x12\x03.\x1d\x1e\n\\\n\x04\x05\x00\x02\x01\x12\x030\x02\x17\x1aO Probe for an exact prior materialisation and reuse it instead of recomputing.\n\n\x0c\n\x05\x05\x00\x02\x01\x01\x12\x030\x02\x12\n\x0c\n\x05\x05\x00\x02\x01\x02\x12\x030\x15\x16\nC\n\x04\x05\x00\x02\x02\x12\x032\x02\x1a\x1a6 Always recompute (the explicit form of the default).\n\n\x0c\n\x05\x05\x00\x02\x02\x01\x12\x032\x02\x15\n\x0c\n\x05\x05\x00\x02\x02\x02\x12\x032\x18\x19\n\xf8\x01\n\x02\x05\x01\x12\x048\x00>\x01\x1a\xeb\x01 Which path a producer took under a `CachePolicy`, so reuse is observable on\n the wire, never inferred. EmbeddingService \xe2\x80\x94 the wire surface for the engine\'s embedding compute\n verbs. These are imperative session methods, not SQL queries, so they live\n as typed gRPC RPCs alongside InferenceService / TriggerService rather than on\n the Flight SQL surface (which carries query/result only, per ADR-01 \xc2\xa73.2).\n\n The surface is modality-agnostic: one GenerateEmbeddings / EncodeQuery pair\n keyed by a `Modality` selects the text, image, or audio tower, rather than a\n verb per modality. Each verb delegates 1:1 to the consumer-facing\n `Session` abstraction, which dispatches the modality onto the\n engine\'s concrete tower method \xe2\x80\x94 the service reimplements no decode,\n feature-extraction, or forward logic; it is purely a wire adapter over the\n in-process engine. Jammi stays non-generative: these encode input \xe2\x86\x92 vector,\n never generate.\n\n Source registration and model introspection \xe2\x80\x94 the control-plane catalog\n surface this compute lane reads \xe2\x80\x94 live on CatalogService, not here. This\n service carries the data-plane compute verbs only.\n\n Tenant scope is read from the request\'s `SessionTenant` extension, set by\n the shared TenantInterceptor from the `jammi-session-id` header \xe2\x80\x94 the same\n mechanism CatalogService / TriggerService / Flight SQL already use.\n\n\n\n\x03\x06\x00\x01\x12\x03\x1b\x08\x18\n\xe2\x02\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x00\x12\x03!\x02J\x1a\xd4\x02 Scan `columns` on a registered source, run the modality\'s tower over\n every row (decode/feature-extraction as the modality requires \xe2\x86\x92 forward\n pass), persist one L2-normalized vector per row keyed by `key_column`,\n and return the result-table record. The `modality` selects which tower.\n Peer of the abstraction\'s `generate_embeddings`.\n\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x00\x01\x12\x03!\x06\x18\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x00\x02\x12\x03!\x192\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x00\x03\x12\x03!=H\n\x91\x02\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x01\x12\x03\'\x02D\x1a\x83\x02 Encode a single query into one L2-normalized embedding with the modality\'s\n tower. The `modality` selects the tower; the `input` oneof must match it \xe2\x80\x94\n `text` for TEXT, `data` (raw encoded bytes) for IMAGE/AUDIO. Peer of the\n abstraction\'s `encode_query`.\n\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x01\x01\x12\x03\'\x06\x11\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x01\x02\x12\x03\'\x12$\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x01\x03\x12\x03\'/B\n\xf8\x03\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x02\x12\x030\x025\x1a\xea\x03 Nearest-neighbor search over a source\'s embedding table. CatalogService \xe2\x80\x94 the engine\'s single control-plane surface: every\n catalog / metadata / lifecycle / observability RPC a remote client reaches.\n The verbs are imperative session methods (registry reads + lifecycle\n mutations), not SQL queries, so they live as typed gRPC RPCs distinct from\n the Flight SQL data-plane (which carries query/result only, per ADR-01\n \xc2\xa73.2) and the compute/stream data-plane services (embedding / inference /\n training / eval / pipeline / trigger / audit).\n\n Each verb delegates 1:1 to the consumer-facing `Session`\n abstraction; the service reimplements no catalog or lifecycle logic. The\n service spans five control concerns. Session: `SetTenant` / `GetTenant` /\n `ClearTenant` bind, read, and clear the calling session\'s tenant, and\n `GetServerInfo` is the capability handshake \xe2\x80\x94 the tenant trio is stateless\n w.r.t. the engine (it updates an in-process session table the\n TenantInterceptor reads on every downstream request) and `GetServerInfo`\n reports compile-time facts plus the runtime tier set, so both mount on the\n always-present core tier. Sources / models: `AddSource` / `RemoveSource` /\n `ListSources` / `DescribeSource` register and introspect data sources, and\n `ListModels` / `DescribeModel` introspect the model catalog while\n `DeleteModel` removes a model row. Channels:\n `RegisterChannel` / `AddChannelColumns` / `ListChannels` declare and\n introspect provenance channels. Mutable tables: `CreateMutableTable` /\n `DropMutableTable` / `ListMutableTables` register and introspect mutable\n companion tables. Topics: `RegisterTopic` / `DropTopic` / `ListTopics`\n register and introspect trigger-stream topics (the publish / subscribe\n compute verbs stay on TriggerService).\n\n Tenant scope is read from the request\'s `SessionTenant` extension, set by\n the shared TenantInterceptor from the `jammi-session-id` header \xe2\x80\x94 the same\n mechanism every other gRPC service and Flight SQL use.\n\"I --- session -----------------------------------------------------------\n\n\n\n\x03\x06\x00\x01\x12\x03&\x08\x16\n\xe4\x01\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x00\x12\x03,\x02B\x1a\xd6\x01 Bind a tenant for the calling session. Idempotent \xe2\x80\x94 calling twice with\n the same tenant is a no-op. Replacing an existing binding is allowed\n (the auth layer above the engine validates the caller is permitted).\n\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x00\x01\x12\x03,\x06\x0f\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x00\x02\x12\x03,\x10 \n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x00\x03\x12\x03,+@\nn\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x01\x12\x030\x02C\x1aa Return the tenant currently bound to the calling session, or an unset\n tenant if none is bound.\n\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x01\x01\x12\x030\x06\x0f\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x01\x02\x12\x030\x10%\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x01\x03\x12\x0300A\n\x96\x01\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x02\x12\x034\x02I\x1a\x88\x01 Clear the tenant binding for the calling session. After this returns,\n subsequent requests on the same session see an unscoped tenant.\n\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x02\x01\x12\x034\x06\x11\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x02\x02\x12\x034\x12\'\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x02\x03\x12\x0342G\n\xd3\x01\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x03\x12\x039\x02@\x1a\xc5\x01 Capabilities handshake: the engine\'s version, the feature flags this\n build was compiled with, and the storage backends it can address. Static\n per build, tenant-agnostic, and engine-independent.\n\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x03\x01\x12\x039\x06\x13\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x03\x02\x12\x039\x14)\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x03\x03\x12\x0394>\n\xa9\x03\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x04\x12\x03B\x02B\x1a\xd0\x02 Register a data source so a later GenerateEmbeddings call can scan it.\n Peer of the abstraction\'s `add_source`. The source carries any modality\n the engine supports; the kind here is the storage backend, not the\n content modality. Idempotent only insofar as the engine allows \xe2\x80\x94\n re-registering an id that already exists is an error.\n2I --- sources / models --------------------------------------------------\n\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x04\x01\x12\x03B\x06\x0f\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x04\x02\x12\x03B\x10 \n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x04\x03\x12\x03B+@\n\x8b\x01\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x05\x12\x03F\x02H\x1a~ Remove a registered source and all associated state (embedding tables,\n indexes). Peer of the abstraction\'s `remove_source`.\n\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x05\x01\x12\x03F\x06\x12\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x05\x02\x12\x03F\x13&\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x05\x03\x12\x03F1F\n\xc0\x02\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x06\x12\x03M\x02D\x1a\xb2\x02 List a `SourceDescriptor` for every source registered to the calling\n tenant. Peer of the abstraction\'s `list_sources`; registry introspection,\n not a SQL query. `ListSources` is `DescribeSource` applied over every\n registered source \xe2\x80\x94 one descriptor shape, one operator, no per-source\n special-casing.\n\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x06\x01\x12\x03M\x06\x11\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x06\x02\x12\x03M\x12$\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x06\x03\x12\x03M/B\n\xf7\x01\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x07\x12\x03S\x02G\x1a\xe9\x01 Describe one registered source: its registry identity (id / kind /\n lifecycle status) plus the result tables embedded out of it (each carrying\n its own status / row_count / dimensions). Peer of the abstraction\'s\n `describe_source`.\n\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x07\x01\x12\x03S\x06\x14\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x07\x02\x12\x03S\x15*\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x07\x03\x12\x03S5E\n\xab\x01\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x08\x12\x03X\x02A\x1a\x9d\x01 List a `Model` record for every model registered to the calling tenant.\n Peer of the abstraction\'s `list_models`; registry introspection, not a SQL\n query.\n\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x08\x01\x12\x03X\x06\x10\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x08\x02\x12\x03X\x11\"\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x08\x03\x12\x03X-?\n\xd9\x01\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\t\x12\x03]\x02:\x1a\xcb\x01 Describe one registered model by id: the same `Model` projection\n `ListModels` carries, for the latest registered version. Peer of the\n abstraction\'s `describe_model`. An absent model returns NotFound.\n\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\t\x01\x12\x03]\x06\x13\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\t\x02\x12\x03]\x14(\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\t\x03\x12\x03]38\n\xb6\x03\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\n\x12\x03e\x02F\x1a\xa8\x03 Hard-delete a model row. Peer of the abstraction\'s `delete_model`. This\n removes the row, so it is refused with `FailedPrecondition` while any\n reference still points at the model (a result table, a training job\'s base\n or output model, an eval run). When `version` is unset the latest version\n is targeted. A tenant may delete ONLY a model it owns. `if_exists` makes a\n missing model a no-op rather than a NotFound error.\n\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\n\x01\x12\x03e\x06\x11\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\n\x02\x12\x03e\x12$\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\n\x03\x12\x03e/D\n\xbf\x01\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x0b\x12\x03k\x02N\x1ag Register a provenance channel and its initial columns. Peer of the\n abstraction\'s `register_channel`.\n2I --- channels ----------------------------------------------------------\n\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x0b\x01\x12\x03k\x06\x15\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x0b\x02\x12\x03k\x16,\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x0b\x03\x12\x03k7L\n\x7f\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x0c\x12\x03o\x02R\x1ar Append columns to an already-registered channel (append-only). Peer of the\n abstraction\'s `add_channel_columns`.\n\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x0c\x01\x12\x03o\x06\x17\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x0c\x02\x12\x03o\x180\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x0c\x03\x12\x03o;P\n\xbf\x01\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\r\x12\x03t\x02G\x1a\xb1\x01 List every channel registered to the calling tenant, ordered by\n `(priority, channel_id)`. Peer of the abstraction\'s `list_channels`;\n registry introspection, not a SQL query.\n\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\r\x01\x12\x03t\x06\x12\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\r\x02\x12\x03t\x13&\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\r\x03\x12\x03t1E\n\xa8\x03\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x0e\x12\x04}\x02~.\x1a\xce\x02 Recompute a materialised result table\'s artifact digest and check it (and,\n if given, an expected definition hash) against its `.materialization.json`\n manifest. Read-only; returns a verdict, never acting on one. Peer of the\n abstraction\'s `verify_materialization`. The verdict attests the Parquet\n data, never the ANN search index.\n2I --- materialization contract ------------------------------------------\n\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x0e\x01\x12\x03}\x06\x1b\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x0e\x02\x12\x03}\x1c8\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x0e\x03\x12\x03~\x0f,\n\xe5\x02\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x0f\x12\x04\x85\x01\x02>\x1a\xd6\x02 Report whether a `ready` result table is still the output of its recorded\n definition over its recorded inputs\' current state. Read-only sensor;\n reports a verdict, never acting on one (recompute / accept / alarm is the\n reader\'s policy). Peer of the abstraction\'s `staleness`. Tenant-scoped: a\n peer cannot sense a table it cannot resolve.\n\n\r\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x0f\x01\x12\x04\x85\x01\x06\x0f\n\r\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x0f\x02\x12\x04\x85\x01\x10 \n\r\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x0f\x03\x12\x04\x85\x01+<\n\xf0\x01\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x10\x12\x04\x8a\x01\x02D\x1a\xe1\x01 Return the one-hop reverse-dependency edges of a result table \xe2\x80\x94 every\n `ready` table that anchored on it. Read-only lineage data; the caller walks\n it transitively. Peer of the abstraction\'s `derives_from`. Tenant-scoped.\n\n\r\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x10\x01\x12\x04\x8a\x01\x06\x11\n\r\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x10\x02\x12\x04\x8a\x01\x12$\n\r\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x10\x03\x12\x04\x8a\x01/B\n\xf1\x01\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x11\x12\x04\x91\x01\x02Y\x1a\x97\x01 Register a mutable companion table. After this returns the table is\n queryable through Flight SQL. Peer of the abstraction\'s\n `create_mutable_table`.\n2I --- mutable tables ----------------------------------------------------\n\n\r\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x11\x01\x12\x04\x91\x01\x06\x18\n\r\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x11\x02\x12\x04\x91\x01\x192\n\r\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x11\x03\x12\x04\x91\x01=W\n`\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x12\x12\x04\x95\x01\x02P\x1aR Drop a mutable companion table. Peer of the abstraction\'s\n `drop_mutable_table`.\n\n\r\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x12\x01\x12\x04\x95\x01\x06\x16\n\r\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x12\x02\x12\x04\x95\x01\x17.\n\r\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x12\x03\x12\x04\x95\x019N\n\xa9\x02\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x13\x12\x04\x9b\x01\x02V\x1a\x9a\x02 List every mutable companion table registered to the calling tenant. Peer\n of the abstraction\'s `list_mutable_tables`; registry introspection, not a\n SQL query. Each entry is the same `MutableTableDefinition` the create path\n carries (minus tenant, which rides the session scope).\n\n\r\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x13\x01\x12\x04\x9b\x01\x06\x17\n\r\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x13\x02\x12\x04\x9b\x01\x180\n\r\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x13\x03\x12\x04\x9b\x01;T\n\x90\x02\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x14\x12\x04\xa2\x01\x02J\x1a\xb6\x01 Register a topic (provisions its backing table) for the trigger stream.\n Peer of the abstraction\'s `register_topic`. The schema is the contract\n every published batch must satisfy.\n2I --- topics ------------------------------------------------------------\n\n\r\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x14\x01\x12\x04\xa2\x01\x06\x13\n\r\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x14\x02\x12\x04\xa2\x01\x14(\n\r\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x14\x03\x12\x04\xa2\x013H\n\xa6\x01\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x15\x12\x04\xa7\x01\x02B\x1a\x97\x01 Drop a topic and its backing table. Peer of the abstraction\'s\n `drop_topic`. `if_exists` makes a missing topic a no-op rather than a\n NotFound error.\n\n\r\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x15\x01\x12\x04\xa7\x01\x06\x0f\n\r\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x15\x02\x12\x04\xa7\x01\x10 \n\r\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x15\x03\x12\x04\xa7\x01+@\nR\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x16\x12\x04\xaa\x01\x02A\x1aD List topics registered in the catalog. Pagination follows AIP-132.\n\n\r\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x16\x01\x12\x04\xaa\x01\x06\x10\n\r\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x16\x02\x12\x04\xaa\x01\x11\"\n\r\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x16\x03\x12\x04\xaa\x01-?\n\xb9\x03\n\x02\x04\x00\x12\x06\xb4\x01\x00\xc6\x01\x01\x1a\xdc\x02 The engine\'s self-description, returned by GetServerInfo. `version`,\n `features`, and `storage_backends` are compile-time facts about the running\n binary; `services` is the runtime tier handshake \xe2\x80\x94 which gRPC service tiers\n this particular deployment actually mounted. Together they let a client\n negotiate capability without probing each verb.\n2L === session ==============================================================\n\n\x0b\n\x03\x04\x00\x01\x12\x04\xb4\x01\x08\x12\nR\n\x04\x04\x00\x02\x00\x12\x04\xb6\x01\x02\x15\x1aD The engine version (the `jammi` workspace version, e.g. \"0.17.0\").\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x00\x02\x00\x05\x12\x04\xb6\x01\x02\x08\n\r\n\x05\x04\x00\x02\x00\x01\x12\x04\xb6\x01\t\x10\n\r\n\x05\x04\x00\x02\x00\x03\x12\x04\xb6\x01\x13\x14\n\x81\x01\n\x04\x04\x00\x02\x01\x12\x04\xb9\x01\x02\x1f\x1as Engine capability feature flags compiled into this build (e.g. \"postgres\",\n \"mysql\", \"jetstream-broker\"), sorted.\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x00\x02\x01\x04\x12\x04\xb9\x01\x02\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x00\x02\x01\x05\x12\x04\xb9\x01\x0b\x11\n\r\n\x05\x04\x00\x02\x01\x01\x12\x04\xb9\x01\x12\x1a\n\r\n\x05\x04\x00\x02\x01\x03\x12\x04\xb9\x01\x1d\x1e\n\xa1\x01\n\x04\x04\x00\x02\x02\x12\x04\xbc\x01\x02\'\x1a\x92\x01 Storage URL schemes this build can address (always \"file\" and \"memory\";\n cloud schemes appear when their driver feature is compiled in), sorted.\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x00\x02\x02\x04\x12\x04\xbc\x01\x02\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x00\x02\x02\x05\x12\x04\xbc\x01\x0b\x11\n\r\n\x05\x04\x00\x02\x02\x01\x12\x04\xbc\x01\x12\"\n\r\n\x05\x04\x00\x02\x02\x03\x12\x04\xbc\x01%&\n\x9d\x04\n\x04\x04\x00\x02\x03\x12\x04\xc5\x01\x02\x1f\x1a\x8e\x04 The gRPC service tiers this deployment mounted, sorted. The core tier\n (catalog/embedding/inference + introspection) is always present; the\n optional tiers (\"train\", \"event\", \"eval\") appear only when both their\n compile feature is present and the deployment\'s config enabled them. A\n client reads this to know which verbs are reachable on *this* server \xe2\x80\x94\n reaching an unmounted tier returns a truthful \"not enabled\" error. The\n embedded (in-process, `file://`) engine mounts no gRPC services, so it\n reports an empty list.\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x00\x02\x03\x04\x12\x04\xc5\x01\x02\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x00\x02\x03\x05\x12\x04\xc5\x01\x0b\x11\n\r\n\x05\x04\x00\x02\x03\x01\x12\x04\xc5\x01\x12\x1a\n\r\n\x05\x04\x00\x02\x03\x03\x12\x04\xc5\x01\x1d\x1e\n\xb1\x01\n\x02\x04\x01\x12\x06\xcb\x01\x00\xce\x01\x01\x1a\xa2\x01 A tenant identifier carried over the wire. UUID v4 / v7 string per ADR-00;\n the nil UUID is invalid and the engine rejects it at the TenantId newtype\n boundary.\n\n\x0b\n\x03\x04\x01\x01\x12\x04\xcb\x01\x08\x0e\nB\n\x04\x04\x01\x02\x00\x12\x04\xcd\x01\x02\x10\x1a4 UUID string. Empty string means \"no tenant bound\".\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x01\x02\x00\x05\x12\x04\xcd\x01\x02\x08\n\r\n\x05\x04\x01\x02\x00\x01\x12\x04\xcd\x01\t\x0b\n\r\n\x05\x04\x01\x02\x00\x03\x12\x04\xcd\x01\x0e\x0f\n\x0c\n\x02\x04\x02\x12\x06\xd0\x01\x00\xd2\x01\x01\n\x0b\n\x03\x04\x02\x01\x12\x04\xd0\x01\x08\x18\n\x0c\n\x04\x04\x02\x02\x00\x12\x04\xd1\x01\x02\x14\n\r\n\x05\x04\x02\x02\x00\x06\x12\x04\xd1\x01\x02\x08\n\r\n\x05\x04\x02\x02\x00\x01\x12\x04\xd1\x01\t\x0f\n\r\n\x05\x04\x02\x02\x00\x03\x12\x04\xd1\x01\x12\x13\n\x0c\n\x02\x04\x03\x12\x06\xd4\x01\x00\xd6\x01\x01\n\x0b\n\x03\x04\x03\x01\x12\x04\xd4\x01\x08\x19\n\x0c\n\x04\x04\x03\x02\x00\x12\x04\xd5\x01\x02\x14\n\r\n\x05\x04\x03\x02\x00\x06\x12\x04\xd5\x01\x02\x08\n\r\n\x05\x04\x03\x02\x00\x01\x12\x04\xd5\x01\t\x0f\n\r\n\x05\x04\x03\x02\x00\x03\x12\x04\xd5\x01\x12\x13\n\xf0\x01\n\x02\x05\x00\x12\x06\xdc\x01\x00\xe1\x01\x01\x1a\x93\x01 Source backend kind. Mirrors the engine\'s `SourceType`. EvalService \xe2\x80\x94 the wire surface for the engine\'s evaluation verbs.\n\n `EvalEmbeddings`, `EvalPerQuery`, `EvalInference`, and `EvalCompare` are\n imperative session methods, not SQL queries, so they live as typed gRPC RPCs\n alongside SessionService / TriggerService / EmbeddingService / Inference-\n Service rather than on the Flight SQL surface (which carries query/result\n only, per ADR-01 \xc2\xa73.2). The verbs are substrate primitives \xe2\x80\x94 measuring model\n quality against golden data \xe2\x80\x94 and name no tenant-domain concept.\n\n Each verb delegates 1:1 to the consumer-facing `Session`\n abstraction; the service reimplements no metric, retrieval, or scan logic.\n The response messages mirror the Rust report structs the abstraction returns\n (`EmbeddingEvalReport`, `InferenceEvalReport`, `CompareEvalReport`, and the\n catalog\'s `PerQueryEvalRecord`) with typed fields, not opaque JSON.\n\n Tenant scope is read from the request\'s `SessionTenant` extension, set by the\n shared TenantInterceptor from the `jammi-session-id` header \xe2\x80\x94 the same\n mechanism every other gRPC service and Flight SQL already use.\n\n\n\n\x03\x06\x00\x01\x12\x03\x16\x08\x13\n\x81\x01\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x00\x12\x03\x19\x02J\x1at Evaluate embedding retrieval quality against a golden relevance set.\n Peer of the abstraction\'s `eval_embeddings`.\n\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x00\x01\x12\x03\x19\x06\x14\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x00\x02\x12\x03\x19\x15*\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x00\x03\x12\x03\x195H\nu\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x01\x12\x03\x1d\x02G\x1ah Read back the persisted per-query eval records for a run. \n\xf4\n\n\x02\x06\x00\x12\x04\x1e\x00?\x01\x1a\xe7\n PipelineService \xe2\x80\x94 the wire surface for the engine\'s compute-to-data engine-\n state verbs that build durable graph/embedding artifacts or assemble a\n target\'s conditioning context.\n\n `BuildNeighborGraph`, `PropagateEmbeddings`, and `AssembleContext` are\n imperative session methods, not SQL queries, so they live as typed gRPC RPCs\n alongside SessionService / EmbeddingService / InferenceService / EvalService\n rather than on the Flight SQL surface (which carries query/result only, per\n ADR-01 \xc2\xa73.2). They are substrate primitives \xe2\x80\x94 materialising a k-NN graph,\n propagating features over a declared graph, or pooling a retrieval into a\n fixed-width context vector \xe2\x80\x94 and name no tenant-domain concept.\n\n Each verb delegates 1:1 to the engine session; the service reimplements no\n retrieval, graph, or aggregation logic \xe2\x80\x94 it is purely a wire adapter over the\n in-process engine. The two graph-build verbs transport only a result-table\n name (the compute stays server-side, so the materialised table is\n byte-identical to one built in-process); `AssembleContext` carries its pooled\n vector inline as IEEE-754 `float` (bit-exact for the engine\'s `Vec<f32>`).\n\n Tenant scope is read from the request\'s `SessionTenant` extension, set by the\n shared TenantInterceptor from the `jammi-session-id` header \xe2\x80\x94 the same\n mechanism every other gRPC service and Flight SQL already use.\n\n\n\n\x03\x06\x00\x01\x12\x03\x1e\x08\x17\n\xd0\x01\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x00\x12\x03\"\x02]\x1a\xc2\x01 Materialise the k-nearest-neighbour graph of a source\'s embedding table and\n return the new edge table. Mirrors the engine\'s\n `build_neighbor_graph` binding: the count `k` is required; `min_similarity`,\n `mutual`, `exact`, and `table` are optional with explicit presence so an unset\n field resolves to the engine default rather than a literal `0`/`false`/`\"\"`.\n The engine-side build knobs `self_exclude` / `exact_max_rows` / `resolve_keys`\n are not on the wire \xe2\x80\x94 the server applies the engine defaults, the single\n source of those values.\n\n\x0b\n\x03\x04\x06\x01\x12\x04\xc1\x01\x08!\nE\n\x04\x04\x06\x02\x00\x12\x04\xc3\x01\x02\x17\x1a7 Source whose embedding table the graph is built over.\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x06\x02\x00\x05\x12\x04\xc3\x01\x02\x08\n\r\n\x05\x04\x06\x02\x00\x01\x12\x04\xc3\x01\t\x12\n\r\n\x05\x04\x06\x02\x00\x03\x12\x04\xc3\x01\x15\x16\n2\n\x04\x04\x06\x02\x01\x12\x04\xc5\x01\x02\x0f\x1a$ Neighbourhood size `k` (required).\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x06\x02\x01\x05\x12\x04\xc5\x01\x02\x08\n\r\n\x05\x04\x06\x02\x01\x01\x12\x04\xc5\x01\t\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x06\x02\x01\x03\x12\x04\xc5\x01\r\x0e\nE\n\x04\x04\x06\x02\x02\x12\x04\xc7\x01\x02$\x1a7 Optional minimum cosine similarity floor for an edge.\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x06\x02\x02\x04\x12\x04\xc7\x01\x02\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x06\x02\x02\x05\x12\x04\xc7\x01\x0b\x10\n\r\n\x05\x04\x06\x02\x02\x01\x12\x04\xc7\x01\x11\x1f\n\r\n\x05\x04\x06\x02\x02\x03\x12\x04\xc7\x01\"#\n+\n\x04\x04\x06\x02\x03\x12\x04\xc9\x01\x02\x12\x1a\x1d Keep only reciprocal edges.\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x06\x02\x03\x05\x12\x04\xc9\x01\x02\x06\n\r\n\x05\x04\x06\x02\x03\x01\x12\x04\xc9\x01\x07\r\n\r\n\x05\x04\x06\x02\x03\x03\x12\x04\xc9\x01\x10\x11\n\x99\x01\n\x04\x04\x06\x02\x04\x12\x04\xcc\x01\x02\x11\x1a\x8a\x01 Use the exact (deterministic, complete) driver, gated by a row-count\n ceiling; UNSPECIFIED maps to the engine default (`Bypass`). Mirrors the\n engine\'s `PropagationWeighting`; UNSPECIFIED maps to the engine default\n (`DegreeNormalized`).\n\n\x0b\n\x03\x05\x03\x01\x12\x04\xd9\x01\x05\x19\n\x0c\n\x04\x05\x03\x02\x00\x12\x04\xda\x01\x02(\n\r\n\x05\x05\x03\x02\x00\x01\x12\x04\xda\x01\x02#\n\r\n\x05\x05\x03\x02\x00\x02\x12\x04\xda\x01&\'\n\x0c\n\x04\x05\x03\x02\x01\x12\x04\xdb\x01\x02.\n\r\n\x05\x05\x03\x02\x01\x01\x12\x04\xdb\x01\x02)\n\r\n\x05\x05\x03\x02\x01\x02\x12\x04\xdb\x01,-\n\x0c\n\x04\x05\x03\x02\x02\x12\x04\xdc\x01\x02$\n\r\n\x05\x05\x03\x02\x02\x01\x12\x04\xdc\x01\x02\x1f\n\r\n\x05\x05\x03\x02\x02\x02\x12\x04\xdc\x01\"#\n\x0c\n\x04\x05\x03\x02\x03\x12\x04\xdd\x01\x02,\n\r\n\x05\x05\x03\x02\x03\x01\x12\x04\xdd\x01\x02\'\n\r\n\x05\x05\x03\x02\x03\x02\x12\x04\xdd\x01*+\n\x86\x01\n\x02\x05\x04\x12\x06\xe2\x01\x00\xe6\x01\x01\x1ax What a propagation emits. Mirrors the engine\'s `PropagationOutput`;\n UNSPECIFIED maps to the engine default (`Final`).\n\n\x0b\n\x03\x05\x04\x01\x12\x04\xe2\x01\x05\x16\n\x0c\n\x04\x05\x04\x02\x00\x12\x04\xe3\x01\x02%\n\r\n\x05\x05\x04\x02\x00\x01\x12\x04\xe3\x01\x02 \n\r\n\x05\x05\x04\x02\x00\x02\x12\x04\xe3\x01#$\n\x0c\n\x04\x05\x04\x02\x01\x12\x04\xe4\x01\x02\x1f\n\r\n\x05\x05\x04\x02\x01\x01\x12\x04\xe4\x01\x02\x1a\n\r\n\x05\x05\x04\x02\x01\x02\x12\x04\xe4\x01\x1d\x1e\n\x0c\n\x04\x05\x04\x02\x02\x12\x04\xe5\x01\x02+\n\r\n\x05\x05\x04\x02\x02\x01\x12\x04\xe5\x01\x02&\n\r\n\x05\x05\x04\x02\x02\x02\x12\x04\xe5\x01)*\n\xdd\x01\n\x02\x04\x07\x12\x06\xeb\x01\x00\xf4\x01\x01\x1a\xce\x01 A registered external edge source and its column bindings, for the\n `edge_source` arm of a propagation. The endpoints join to the source on the\n key; `weight_column` feeds the `edge_similarity` weighting.\n\n\x0b\n\x03\x04\x07\x01\x12\x04\xeb\x01\x08\x1b\n;\n\x04\x04\x07\x02\x00\x12\x04\xed\x01\x02\x19\x1a- Registered source id holding the edge rows.\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x07\x02\x00\x05\x12\x04\xed\x01\x02\x08\n\r\n\x05\x04\x07\x02\x00\x01\x12\x04\xed\x01\t\x14\n\r\n\x05\x04\x07\x02\x00\x03\x12\x04\xed\x01\x17\x18\nU\n\x04\x04\x07\x02\x01\x12\x04\xef\x01\x02\x18\x1aG Column holding the edge\'s source endpoint (default \"src\" when empty).\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x07\x02\x01\x05\x12\x04\xef\x01\x02\x08\n\r\n\x05\x04\x07\x02\x01\x01\x12\x04\xef\x01\t\x13\n\r\n\x05\x04\x07\x02\x01\x03\x12\x04\xef\x01\x16\x17\nZ\n\x04\x04\x07\x02\x02\x12\x04\xf1\x01\x02\x18\x1aL Column holding the edge\'s destination endpoint (default \"dst\" when empty).\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x07\x02\x02\x05\x12\x04\xf1\x01\x02\x08\n\r\n\x05\x04\x07\x02\x02\x01\x12\x04\xf1\x01\t\x13\n\r\n\x05\x04\x07\x02\x02\x03\x12\x04\xf1\x01\x16\x17\n8\n\x04\x04\x07\x02\x03\x12\x04\xf3\x01\x02$\x1a* Optional column holding the edge weight.\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x07\x02\x03\x04\x12\x04\xf3\x01\x02\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x07\x02\x03\x05\x12\x04\xf3\x01\x0b\x11\n\r\n\x05\x04\x07\x02\x03\x01\x12\x04\xf3\x01\x12\x1f\n\r\n\x05\x04\x07\x02\x03\x03\x12\x04\xf3\x01\"#\n\xc8\x03\n\x02\x04\x08\x12\x06\xfc\x01\x00\x98\x02\x01\x1a\xb9\x03 Propagate an embedding table\'s features over a declared graph. Mirrors the\n engine\'s `propagate_embeddings` binding. The graph is either an S9 similarity\n graph (`edge_graph_table`, a `build_neighbor_graph` output) or a registered\n external edge source (`edge_source`) \xe2\x80\x94 exactly one, modelled as a `oneof` so\n both/neither is a decode error. The optional scalars carry explicit presence\n so an unset field resolves to the engine default.\n\n\x0b\n\x03\x04\x08\x01\x12\x04\xfc\x01\x08\"\nS\n\x04\x04\x08\x02\x00\x12\x04\xfe\x01\x02\x17\x1aE Source whose embedding table holds the input features `X\xe2\x81\xbd\xe2\x81\xb0\xe2\x81\xbe`.\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x00\x05\x12\x04\xfe\x01\x02\x08\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x00\x01\x12\x04\xfe\x01\t\x12\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x00\x03\x12\x04\xfe\x01\x15\x16\nW\n\x04\x04\x08\x02\x01\x12\x04\x80\x02\x02&\x1aI Optional specific embedding table; unset resolves the source\'s default.\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x01\x04\x12\x04\x80\x02\x02\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x01\x05\x12\x04\x80\x02\x0b\x11\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x01\x01\x12\x04\x80\x02\x12!\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x01\x03\x12\x04\x80\x02$%\nB\n\x04\x04\x08\x08\x00\x12\x06\x82\x02\x02\x87\x02\x03\x1a2 The graph to propagate over \xe2\x80\x94 exactly one arm.\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x08\x00\x01\x12\x04\x82\x02\x08\r\nT\n\x04\x04\x08\x02\x02\x12\x04\x84\x02\x04 \x1aF An S9 similarity graph (a `build_neighbor_graph` output table name).\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x02\x05\x12\x04\x84\x02\x04\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x02\x01\x12\x04\x84\x02\x0b\x1b\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x02\x03\x12\x04\x84\x02\x1e\x1f\nH\n\x04\x04\x08\x02\x03\x12\x04\x86\x02\x04(\x1a: A registered external edge source + its column bindings.\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x03\x06\x12\x04\x86\x02\x04\x17\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x03\x01\x12\x04\x86\x02\x18#\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x03\x03\x12\x04\x86\x02&\'\nu\n\x04\x04\x08\x02\x04\x12\x04\x8a\x02\x021\x1ag Edge direction read when building the neighbourhood. UNSPECIFIED maps to the\n engine default (`Out`).\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x04\x06\x12\x04\x8a\x02\x02\"\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x04\x01\x12\x04\x8a\x02#,\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x04\x03\x12\x04\x8a\x02/0\nC\n\x04\x04\x08\x02\x05\x12\x04\x8c\x02\x02\x1b\x1a5 Optional hop count (clamped to the engine hop cap).\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x05\x04\x12\x04\x8c\x02\x02\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x05\x05\x12\x04\x8c\x02\x0b\x11\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x05\x01\x12\x04\x8c\x02\x12\x16\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x05\x03\x12\x04\x8c\x02\x19\x1a\n1\n\x04\x04\x08\x02\x06\x12\x04\x8e\x02\x02%\x1a# Neighbour-contribution weighting.\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x06\x06\x12\x04\x8e\x02\x02\x16\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x06\x01\x12\x04\x8e\x02\x17 \n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x06\x03\x12\x04\x8e\x02#$\n4\n\x04\x04\x08\x02\x07\x12\x04\x90\x02\x02\x1c\x1a& Optional APPNP teleport probability.\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x07\x04\x12\x04\x90\x02\x02\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x07\x05\x12\x04\x90\x02\x0b\x11\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x07\x01\x12\x04\x90\x02\x12\x17\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x07\x03\x12\x04\x90\x02\x1a\x1b\n+\n\x04\x04\x08\x02\x08\x12\x04\x92\x02\x02\x1f\x1a\x1d What the propagation emits.\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x08\x06\x12\x04\x92\x02\x02\x13\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x08\x01\x12\x04\x92\x02\x14\x1a\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\x08\x03\x12\x04\x92\x02\x1d\x1e\n\x80\x02\n\x04\x04\x08\x02\t\x12\x04\x97\x02\x02,\x1a\xf1\x01 Opt-in memoization. UNSPECIFIED maps to the engine default (`Bypass`). A\n propagation is anchored on the immutable source-embedding-table and\n edge-relation digests, so it is genuinely cacheable: a `Use` request reuses\n an exact prior run.\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\t\x06\x12\x04\x97\x02\x02 \n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\t\x01\x12\x04\x97\x02!&\n\r\n\x05\x04\x08\x02\t\x03\x12\x04\x97\x02)+\n\xb3\x01\n\x02\x05\x05\x12\x06\x9d\x02\x00\xa2\x02\x01\x1a\xa4\x01 Which permutation-invariant reduction the context-set encoder pools with.\n Mirrors the engine\'s `SetAggregator`; UNSPECIFIED maps to the engine default\n (`Mean`).\n\n\x0b\n\x03\x05\x05\x01\x12\x04\x9d\x02\x05\x12\n\x0c\n\x04\x05\x05\x02\x00\x12\x04\x9e\x02\x02!\n\r\n\x05\x05\x05\x02\x00\x01\x12\x04\x9e\x02\x02\x1c\n\r\n\x05\x05\x05\x02\x00\x02\x12\x04\x9e\x02\x1f \n\x0c\n\x04\x05\x05\x02\x01\x12\x04\x9f\x02\x02\x1a\n\r\n\x05\x05\x05\x02\x01\x01\x12\x04\x9f\x02\x02\x15\n\r\n\x05\x05\x05\x02\x01\x02\x12\x04\x9f\x02\x18\x19\n\x0c\n\x04\x05\x05\x02\x02\x12\x04\xa0\x02\x02\x19\n\r\n\x05\x05\x05\x02\x02\x01\x12\x04\xa0\x02\x02\x14\n\r\n\x05\x05\x05\x02\x02\x02\x12\x04\xa0\x02\x17\x18\n\x0c\n\x04\x05\x05\x02\x03\x12\x04\xa1\x02\x02\x19\n\r\n\x05\x05\x05\x02\x03\x01\x12\x04\xa1\x02\x02\x14\n\r\n\x05\x05\x05\x02\x03\x02\x12\x04\xa1\x02\x17\x18\n\xb5\x02\n\x02\x04\t\x12\x06\xa8\x02\x00\xc5\x02\x01\x1a\xa6\x02 Assemble and encode a target\'s context set. Mirrors the engine\'s\n `assemble_context` binding. `query` is the target\'s vector; an absent\n `edges` block is the ANN-only default, a present block (without `hybrid`) is a\n declared-edge walk, and a present block with `hybrid` is the union of both.\n\n\x0b\n\x03\x04\t\x01\x12\x04\xa8\x02\x08\x1e\n\x87\x01\n\x04\x04\t\x02\x00\x12\x04\xab\x02\x02\x17\x1ay Source whose embedding table the context is retrieved against and whose rows\n the members are pooled and hydrated from.\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x00\x05\x12\x04\xab\x02\x02\x08\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x00\x01\x12\x04\xab\x02\t\x12\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x00\x03\x12\x04\xab\x02\x15\x16\n\x97\x01\n\x04\x04\t\x02\x01\x12\x04\xae\x02\x02\x1b\x1a\x88\x01 The target\'s query vector \xe2\x80\x94 the point whose neighbourhood is the context.\n IEEE-754 `float` (bit-exact for the engine\'s `Vec<f32>`).\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x01\x04\x12\x04\xae\x02\x02\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x01\x05\x12\x04\xae\x02\x0b\x10\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x01\x01\x12\x04\xae\x02\x11\x16\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x01\x03\x12\x04\xae\x02\x19\x1a\n\'\n\x04\x04\t\x02\x02\x12\x04\xb0\x02\x02\x0f\x1a\x19 Neighbourhood size `k`.\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x02\x05\x12\x04\xb0\x02\x02\x08\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x02\x01\x12\x04\xb0\x02\t\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x02\x03\x12\x04\xb0\x02\r\x0e\nP\n\x04\x04\t\x02\x03\x12\x04\xb2\x02\x02$\x1aB Optional label/outcome columns hydrated for each context member.\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x03\x04\x12\x04\xb2\x02\x02\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x03\x05\x12\x04\xb2\x02\x0b\x11\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x03\x01\x12\x04\xb2\x02\x12\x1f\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x03\x03\x12\x04\xb2\x02\"#\n&\n\x04\x04\t\x02\x04\x12\x04\xb4\x02\x02\x1f\x1a\x18 The pooling reduction.\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x04\x06\x12\x04\xb4\x02\x02\x0f\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x04\x01\x12\x04\xb4\x02\x10\x1a\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x04\x03\x12\x04\xb4\x02\x1d\x1e\n\xd9\x02\n\x04\x04\t\x02\x05\x12\x04\xba\x02\x02!\x1a\xca\x02 Drop the target\'s own row (`exclude_key`) before pooling \xe2\x80\x94 the leakage\n guard. Explicit presence: an unset field resolves to the engine default\n (`true`), the single source of that value, so a client that omits it keeps\n the leakage guard on rather than silently disabling it via the proto3 bare-\n bool wire default (`false`).\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x05\x04\x12\x04\xba\x02\x02\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x05\x05\x12\x04\xba\x02\x0b\x0f\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x05\x01\x12\x04\xba\x02\x10\x1c\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x05\x03\x12\x04\xba\x02\x1f \nU\n\x04\x04\t\x02\x06\x12\x04\xbc\x02\x02\"\x1aG Optional target row key dropped from the context when `exclude_self`.\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x06\x04\x12\x04\xbc\x02\x02\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x06\x05\x12\x04\xbc\x02\x0b\x11\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x06\x01\x12\x04\xbc\x02\x12\x1d\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x06\x03\x12\x04\xbc\x02 !\nF\n\x04\x04\t\x02\x07\x12\x04\xbe\x02\x02\x1c\x1a8 Optional SQL predicate scoping the context to a split.\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x07\x04\x12\x04\xbe\x02\x02\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x07\x05\x12\x04\xbe\x02\x0b\x11\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x07\x01\x12\x04\xbe\x02\x12\x17\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x07\x03\x12\x04\xbe\x02\x1a\x1b\n\x94\x01\n\x04\x04\t\x02\x08\x12\x04\xc1\x02\x023\x1a\x85\x01 Optional declared-edge gather. Absent = ANN-only; present = declared-edge\n walk, or (with `hybrid`) the union with the ANN context.\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x08\x04\x12\x04\xc1\x02\x02\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x08\x06\x12\x04\xc1\x02\x0b(\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x08\x01\x12\x04\xc1\x02).\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\x08\x03\x12\x04\xc1\x0212\n_\n\x04\x04\t\x02\t\x12\x04\xc4\x02\x02\x13\x1aQ Union the declared-edge and ANN candidate sets (only meaningful with\n `edges`).\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\t\x05\x12\x04\xc4\x02\x02\x06\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\t\x01\x12\x04\xc4\x02\x07\r\n\r\n\x05\x04\t\x02\t\x03\x12\x04\xc4\x02\x10\x12\n\xe9\x02\n\x02\x04\n\x12\x06\xcc\x02\x00\xcf\x02\x01\x1a\xda\x02 The pooled fixed-width context vector. A wrapper message (carried as an\n `optional` field) so a degenerate empty context (`None` \xe2\x80\x94 no neighbour\n survived exclusion/split) is distinguishable from a present-but-empty vector:\n the absence is a correctness signal a decoder reads as low-confidence, never\n silently averaged into a representation.\n\n\x0b\n\x03\x04\n\x01\x12\x04\xcc\x02\x08\x15\nI\n\x04\x04\n\x02\x00\x12\x04\xce\x02\x02\x1c\x1a; The pooled vector `\xcf\x81(\xce\xa3 \xcf\x86(x\xe1\xb5\xa2))`, in IEEE-754 `float`.\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\n\x02\x00\x04\x12\x04\xce\x02\x02\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\n\x02\x00\x05\x12\x04\xce\x02\x0b\x10\n\r\n\x05\x04\n\x02\x00\x01\x12\x04\xce\x02\x11\x17\n\r\n\x05\x04\n\x02\x00\x03\x12\x04\xce\x02\x1a\x1b\n\xea\x01\n\x02\x04\x0b\x12\x06\xd4\x02\x00\xe3\x02\x01\x1a\xdb\x01 Result of one AssembleContext invocation. TrainingService \xe2\x80\x94 the wire surface for the engine\'s training verbs.\n\n `StartTraining` and `TrainingStatus` are imperative session methods, not SQL\n queries, so they live as typed gRPC RPCs alongside SessionService /\n TriggerService / EmbeddingService / InferenceService / EvalService rather\n than on the Flight SQL surface (which carries query/result only, per ADR-01\n \xc2\xa73.2). Training is a substrate primitive \xe2\x80\x94 meta-learning an adapter or a\n predictor over a registered source \xe2\x80\x94 and names no tenant-domain concept.\n\n The service serves all three engine training kinds (`fine_tune`,\n `graph_fine_tune`, `context_predictor`) behind one verb: `StartTraining`\n carries a full `TrainingSpec` oneof and dispatches to the matching engine\n submit verb, returning the durable job id and the (deterministic) output\n model id. The job runs asynchronously inside the engine; the client polls\n `TrainingStatus` by id until a terminal state. There is no progress stream \xe2\x80\x94\n the abstraction exposes none, so this surface invents none. The service\n reimplements no training, LoRA, sampling, or scan logic; it is purely a wire\n adapter.\n\n Tenant scope is read from the request\'s `SessionTenant` extension, set by the\n shared TenantInterceptor from the `jammi-session-id` header \xe2\x80\x94 the same\n mechanism every other gRPC service and Flight SQL already use.\n\n\n\n\x03\x06\x00\x01\x12\x03\x1c\x08\x17\n\xb3\x02\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x00\x12\x03!\x02J\x1a\xa5\x02 Submit a training job over a registered source and return its id + output\n model id. The job trains asynchronously; poll `TrainingStatus` with the\n returned job id. Peer of the engine\'s `fine_tune` / `fine_tune_graph` /\n `train_context_predictor` submit verbs (the spec oneof selects which).\n\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x00\x01\x12\x03!\x06\x13\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x00\x02\x12\x03!\x14(\n\x0c\n\x05\x06\x00\x02\x00\x03\x12\x03!3H\n\xa1\x02\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x01\x12\x03\'\x02M\x1a\x93\x02 Read a training job\'s current status by id, plus its output model id and\n the failure message when it failed. When `mine` is set the trainer mines hard negatives\n from its own ANN index, excluding the positive\'s `exclude_hops`-hop\n neighbourhood and re-mining every `refresh_every` epochs.\n\n As with `FineTuneConfig`, every scalar knob is `optional` so an unset field\n is distinguishable from a legal `0`: the server reads an unset field as\n \"apply the engine default\" (`HardNegativeConfig::default()`) and a present\n field as an override. A caller that sets only `mine = true` therefore ships\n the engine\'s `k`/`exclude_hops`/`refresh_every` defaults rather than zeros,\n which `FineTuneConfig::validate` would otherwise reject.\n\n\x0b\n\x03\x04\x03\x01\x12\x04\x9b\x01\x08\x1a\n\x0c\n\x04\x04\x03\x02\x00\x12\x04\x9c\x01\x02\x10\n\r\n\x05\x04\x03\x02\x00\x05\x12\x04\x9c\x01\x02\x06\n\r\n\x05\x04\x03\x02\x00\x01\x12\x04\x9c\x01\x07\x0b\n\r\n\x05\x04\x03\x02\x00\x03\x12\x04\x9c\x01\x0e\x0f\n\x0c\n\x04\x04\x03\x02\x01\x12\x04\x9d\x01\x02\x18\n\r\n\x05\x04\x03\x02\x01\x04\x12\x04\x9d\x01\x02\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x03\x02\x01\x05\x12\x04\x9d\x01\x0b\x11\n\r\n\x05\x04\x03\x02\x01\x01\x12\x04\x9d\x01\x12\x13\n\r\n\x05\x04\x03\x02\x01\x03\x12\x04\x9d\x01\x16\x17\n\x0c\n\x04\x04\x03\x02\x02\x12\x04\x9e\x01\x02#\n\r\n\x05\x04\x03\x02\x02\x04\x12\x04\x9e\x01\x02\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x03\x02\x02\x05\x12\x04\x9e\x01\x0b\x11\n\r\n\x05\x04\x03\x02\x02\x01\x12\x04\x9e\x01\x12\x1e\n\r\n\x05\x04\x03\x02\x02\x03\x12\x04\x9e\x01!\"\n\x0c\n\x04\x04\x03\x02\x03\x12\x04\x9f\x01\x02$\n\r\n\x05\x04\x03\x02\x03\x04\x12\x04\x9f\x01\x02\n\n\r\n\x05\x04\x03\x02\x03\x05\x12\x04\x9f\x01\x0b\x11\n\r\n\x05\x04\x03\x02\x03\x01\x12\x04\x9f\x01\x12\x1f\n\r\n\x05\x04\x03\x02\x03\x03\x12\x04\x9f\x01\"#\n\xae\x05\n\x02\x04\x04\x12\x06\xab\x01\x00\xdb\x01\x01\x1a\x9f\x05 Configuration for a fine-tuning job. Mirrors the engine\'s `FineTuneConfig`\n field for field; every field is read by the trainer or the LoRA builder.\n Every scalar knob is `optional` so an unset field is distinguishable from a\n legal `0`/`false`: the server reads an unset field as \"apply the engine\n default\" (`FineTuneConfig::default()`) and a present field as an override,\n making the engine the single source of default values. `embedding_loss`/\n `classification_loss` are unset to let the engine auto-select from the data\n format; `layers_to_transform` is unset for \"all layers\". AuditService \xe2\x80\x94 the wire surface for the engine\'s per-query audit verbs.\n\n `AuditLog`, `AuditFetchByQueryId`, and `AuditFetchRecent` are imperative\n session methods \xe2\x80\x94 signing, tenant-injection, and signature-verified decode\n are non-SQL logic \xe2\x80\x94 so they live as typed gRPC RPCs alongside the other\n engine-backed services rather than on the Flight SQL surface (query/result\n only, per ADR-01 \xc2\xa73.2). The verbs name a substrate primitive \xe2\x80\x94 a signed\n per-query audit log \xe2\x80\x94 and carry no tenant-domain concept.\n\n Each verb delegates 1:1 to the consumer-facing `Session`\n abstraction (`audit_log` / `audit_fetch_by_query_id` / `audit_fetch_recent`);\n the service reimplements no signing, storage, or query logic. The\n `PerQueryAudit` message mirrors the Rust record field for field, including\n its server-computed `signature`.\n\n Tenant scope is read from the request\'s `SessionTenant` extension, set by the\n shared TenantInterceptor. The audit primitive requires a bound tenant \xe2\x80\x94 an\n unscoped call is rejected by the engine.\n\n\n\n\x03\x06\x00\x01\x12\x03\x18\x08\x14\n\xa1\x01\n\x04\x06\x00\x02\x00\x12\x03\x1b\x02@\x1a\x93\x01 Sign and persist a batch of audit records under the session\'s tenant,\n publishing them to the audit topic. rpc cannot escape coverage by being forgotten in a constant.

# AuditErrorDetail in jammi_wire::proto::error - Rust

Source: https://docs.rs/jammi-wire/0.32.1/jammi_wire/proto/error/struct.AuditErrorDetail.html

## Expand description

AuditErrorDetail — the structured wire detail for `jammi_db::AuditError`,
attached to a `tonic::Status` by the server’s `map_audit_error` so a remote
the data-plane client reconstructs the EXACT `AuditError` the in-process path
returns.

Every owned-shape variant has its own typed arm and reconstructs faithfully.
The only fold is `serde` — `AuditError::Serde(#\[from\] serde_json::Error)`
wraps a foreign error that cannot cross a process boundary, so it carries its
faithful `Display` string (the genuine fidelity limit, mirroring how
`JammiErrorDetail` folds its own foreign `#\[from\]` variants).

with no variant reconstructs as an empty `Storage`.
